name: "For None May Take From Us Our Freedom of Song"
description:
Combat Action: When your active character is Varka, equip this card.
When Varka equips this card, immediately use Windbound Execution once.
When your Varka has this card equipped and is the active character, after you trigger a Swirl Reaction: The next Anemo DMG you deal and the next DMG matching the Swirled Element are each increased by 1. (Once per Round)
(You must have Varka in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
